title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 008 ]

blocks.text: The average brain is naturally lazy and tends to take the line of least resistance. The mental world of the ordinary man consists of beliefs which he has accepted without questioning and to which he is firmly attached; he is instinctively hostile to anything which would upset the established order of this familiar world.

readingSentences.english: The average brain is naturally lazy and tends to take the line of least resistance.
readingSentences.korean: 보통 사람의 두뇌는 선천적으로 게으르며 저항이 가장 적은 길을 택하는 경향이 있다.

readingSentences.english: The mental world of the ordinary man consists of beliefs which he has accepted without questioning and to which he is firmly attached; he is instinctively hostile to anything which would upset the established order of this familiar world.
readingSentences.korean: 평범한 사람들의 정신세계는 의심 없이 받아들이고 굳게 고수해 온 신념들로 구성되어 있어, 그는 이 익숙한 세계의 기존 질서를 뒤흔드는 어떤 것에 대해서도 본능적으로 적대감을 갖는다.
